item.title: Another 'miracle' in Istanbul - but this one hurt Liverpool
item.description: Liverpool conceded "cheap" and "messy" goals in their defeat by Fenerbahce, says boss Andoni Iraola, as former Reds hero Dirk Kuyt celebrates a "miracle" in Istanbul.

item.title: Haaland scores winner as Man City beat Leipzig
item.description: Erling Haaland scores the winning goal as Manchester City overcome being pegged back twice to beat RB Leipzig 3-2 on match day four of the UEFA Champions League group phase.

item.title: Arsenal survive late Slavia scare for hard-fought win
item.description: Arsenal earn their third win from four in the Champions League as goals from Noni Madueke and Victor Gyokeres are too much for Slavia Prague, despite a valiant late fight from the hosts to get back into the game.

item.title: Liverpool crumble at Kuyt's Fenerbahce
item.description: Liverpool are defeated by Turkish side Fenerbahce, who twice fought back from behind to seal a famous victory, ending the Reds' perfect start to this year's Champions League after four games.

item.title: World record 51 red cards shown in Brazilian youth game
item.description: A world record of 43 players and eight members of staff were sent off during an under-20 championship match between Uberlandia and Mamore in Brazil.

item.title: Emery in line for new Villa deal - Thursday's gossip
item.description: Manager Unai Emery is in line for a new contract with Aston Villa, Trey Nyoni to stay with Liverpool and Leeds target Harvey Elliott, plus more.

item.title: Como score nine to make Champions League history
item.description: Anastasios Douvikas scores a hat-trick as Como produce a stunning 9-1 away win over Lens on match day four, recording the biggest away win in Champions League history.

item.title: Valverde stunner earns Real Madrid late win at AEK Athens
item.description: Real Madrid continue their 100% start to their Champions League campaign with another late win, this time through captain Federico Valverde to inflict Athens' third loss in a row.

item.title: Manchester United beat Roma in epic second-half comeback
item.description: Manchester United drag themselves up off the canvas to come from two goals down to record a sensational Champions League victory against Roma at Old Trafford.

item.title: Emphatic Porto thrash Napoli in second-half romp
item.description: Porto score three goals in the final 20 minutes of the game to pull away and seal a comfortable victory against Napoli, who are unable to match their Portuguese opponents in the second half.

item.title: Raphinha scores twice as Barcelona beat Aston Villa
item.description: Barcelona end Aston Villa's perfect Champions League start with an enthralling win at the Spotify Nou Camp.

item.title: An island in mourning: Tenerife processes death of De Miguel
item.description: Tenerife football club and the wider football community mourn the loss of footballer Jesus de Miguel following an on-field collision.

item.title: Why Man Utd's Roma comeback has echoes of Mourinho and Solskjaer
item.description: After their memorable comeback victory against Roma, can Manchester United avoid a repeat of the past and follow that up with a successive victory?

item.title: Real Madrid reach verbal agreement to sign Gabriel
item.description: Real Madrid are confident of winning the race to sign Manchester United forward JJ Gabriel after reaching a verbal agreement with the teenager.

item.title: How landmark Everton compensation prevented Burnley record loss
item.description: Burnley have published promising financial results, but under the hood is a payment from Everton which makes the picture look far less positive.

item.title: Bayern continue unbeaten CL start with win at Atletico
item.description: Bayern Munich continued their unbeaten start to the Champions League season with an assured 2-0 victory at Atletico Madrid.

item.title: Spence stars as Inter Milan cruise to win at Feyenoord
item.description: England full-back Djed Spence staring as Inter Milan bounc back from their derby defeat with a comfortable Champions League victory over Feyenoord.

item.title: Dortmund take narrow win over Real Betis

item.title: Everton hold off Newcastle to move into seventh
item.description: Thierno Barry scores against Newcastle United for the second time in five days as his Everton side earn a narrow win at St James' Park in the Premier League.

item.title: 'He's unavailable' - Moyes tight-lipped on Grealish
item.description: Everton manager David Moyes' post-match reaction to his side's one-goal win against struggling Newcastle United, as well as the availability of Jack Grealish following disciplinary action.

item.title: Jaissle unhappy with 'clear foul' before Barry goal
item.description: Newcastle United head coach Matthias Jaissle takes issue with referee John Brooks' decision not to call a "clear foul" on Fabian Schar in the build-up to Thierno Barry's goal in their loss to Everton in the Premier League.
